deep.reconstruction:
Context: this is a draft of Riemann's 1861 memoir 'Ein Beitrag zu den Untersuchungen über die Bewegung eines gleichartigen flüssigen Ellipsoides', which treats the Dirichlet–Dedekind problem. The motion is the homogeneous linear one x = T(t)·diag(a,b,c)·T1(t)^T·x0. The frame (xi,eta,zeta) is the principal-axis frame of the ellipsoid. A second frame (xi1,eta1,zeta1) is defined by xi/a, eta/b, zeta/c.

(i) Interpretation of earlier formulas (top of page).
- xi', eta', zeta' are the components of the absolute velocity along the moving axes.
- dxi/dt etc. are the relative velocities.
- The left sides of the previous page's (1) are the acceleration components along these axes; the right sides are the accelerating forces eps*dV/dxi - dp/dxi.
- p, q, r are the instantaneous angular velocities of the xi-frame about its own axes; p1, q1, r1 are the same for the xi1-frame.

(ii) Plan of the computation.
- Substitute (6) into (4). Use (5) to re-express xi/a, eta/b, zeta/c in terms of xi, eta, zeta (material derivatives).
- The acceleration components then become linear in xi, eta, zeta.
- On the right, eps*V - p has the form const + A xi^2 + B eta^2 + C zeta^2. The ellipsoid potential is quadratic. With constant surface pressure P one may set p = P(1 - xi^2/a^2 - eta^2/b^2 - zeta^2/c^2).
- Equating the 9 coefficients, together with incompressibility abc = a0 b0 c0, gives equations for the 10 unknown functions a, b, c, p, q, r, p1, q1, r1 (and the pressure parameter).

(iii) Change of variables.
- Introduce u = (p+p1)/2, v = (q+q1)/2, w = (r+r1)/2 and u' = (p-p1)/2, v' = (q-q1)/2, w' = (r-r1)/2.
- Motivation: cyclic permutation of the axes only permutes the corresponding quantities.

(iv) Resulting system (A) (Riemann's system I).
- (a-c)v^2 + (a+c)v'^2 + (a-b)w^2 + (a+b)w'^2 - (1/2) a'' = 2 eps A a - G/a, and its cyclic analogues for b and c.
- (b-c)u_t + 2(b-c)_t u + (b+c-2a) v w + (b+c+2a) v' w' = 0.
- (b+c)u'_t + 2(b+c)_t u' + (b-c+2a) v w' + (b-c-2a) v' w = 0.
- Plus the cyclic versions for (v,v') and (w,w'), not written out.
- The left side of the a-equation equals -(a/2) times the xi-coefficient of the acceleration.
- A, B, C come from the known potential of the homogeneous ellipsoid.

(v) First integrals from general principles.
- Conservation of areas (angular momentum). Its body-frame components are g = (b-c)^2 u + (b+c)^2 u', h = (c-a)^2 v + (c+a)^2 v', k = (a-b)^2 w + (a+b)^2 w'. These equal the projections alpha g0 + beta h0 + gamma k0, etc., of a fixed vector onto the moving axes.
- My check: from the u, u' equations, dg/dt = r h - q k with q = v+v', r = w+w'. So (g,h,k) is a solution of the frame equations of (5)/(8) type, as the page states.
- Helmholtz's conservation of vortex motion gives the analogous vector (2): g1 = (b-c)^2 u - (b+c)^2 u', etc. It is fixed relative to the second frame, with dg1/dt = r1 h1 - q1 k1, r1 = w - w', q1 = v - v'.
- Conservation of vis viva gives (1/2)(a'^2+b'^2+c'^2) + Σ[(b-c)^2 u^2 + (b+c)^2 u'^2] = 2 eps H + const.
- My check: the kinetic energy ∝ ∫|v|^2 computed from (6) is Σa'^2 + 2Σ[(a-b)^2 w^2 + (a+b)^2 w'^2]. This matches.
- The next page derives |g|^2 = const and |g1|^2 = const, and reduces the orientation to quadratures.
errors: The area-integral line is garbled. The page appears to have '(b-c)^2 u ... (b+c)^2 w''; consistency with the u,u' equations and the angular-momentum computation requires g = (b-c)^2 u + (b+c)^2 u' (u', not w').

Factor conventions are unresolved. With V = const - (A xi^2 + B eta^2 + C zeta^2) and p = P(1 - Σ xi^2/a^2), a direct computation gives right side eps*A*a - P/a for the left side as written. The page's '2 eps A a - G/a' therefore presupposes a normalisation of A (and G = 2P or similar) not stated on this page.
Energy consistency requires dH/dt = -2 Σ A a a' under abc = const, given the right side 2 eps A a. This depends on the (unstated) definition of H; not an error, but unverifiable from this page.
The u-equation becomes singular/degenerate when b = c (coefficient of u_t vanishes). Riemann notes this limitation on the next page; it is not a slip.

results.what: Reduction of Dirichlet's homogeneous-linear-motion problem for a self-gravitating incompressible fluid ellipsoid to a 10th-order-type ODE system in a, b, c and the half-sums/differences u, v, w, u', v', w' of the two frame rotation rates
results.modern_name: Riemann's equations for Dirichlet–Dedekind–Riemann ellipsoids (Riemann ellipsoids)
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann 1861 (Abh. Ges. Wiss. Göttingen 9), building on Dirichlet (posthumous, ed. Dedekind 1860) and Dedekind

results.what: Angular momentum vector in body coordinates g = (b-c)^2 u + (b+c)^2 u' (cyclic), constant in space
results.modern_name: conservation of angular momentum for Riemann ellipsoids

results.what: Vorticity/circulation vector g1 = (b-c)^2 u - (b+c)^2 u' fixed relative to the second (label) frame, via Helmholtz's vortex theorem
results.modern_name: conservation of circulation/vorticity (Helmholtz–Kelvin); Dedekind adjoint symmetry

results.what: Energy integral (1/2)Σa'^2 + Σ[(b-c)^2u^2 + (b+c)^2u'^2] = 2 eps H + const
results.modern_name: energy conservation (vis viva) for the ellipsoid ODE system

deep.surprise_reason: This page is a draft of the published 1861 memoir on the fluid ellipsoid. The u,v,w,u',v',w' system and its integrals are well known as Riemann's (Werke; Chandrasekhar's Ellipsoidal Figures). Only drafting details are new.

checkable.sympy: a,b,c,u,v,w,up,vp,wp,ad,bd,cd=symbols('a b c u v w up vp wp ad bd cd'); ut=-(2*(bd-cd)*u+(b+c-2*a)*v*w+(b+c+2*a)*vp*wp)/(b-c); upt=-(2*(bd+cd)*up+(b-c+2*a)*v*wp+(b-c-2*a)*vp*w)/(b+c); dg=2*(b-c)*(bd-cd)*u+(b-c)**2*ut+2*(b+c)*(bd+cd)*up+(b+c)**2*upt; h=(c-a)**2*v+(c+a)**2*vp; k=(a-b)**2*w+(a+b)**2*wp; simplify(dg-((w+wp)*h-(v+vp)*k))==0
checkable.asserts: The u,u' equations imply d/dt[(b-c)^2u+(b+c)^2u'] = r h - q k, i.e. the angular-momentum components form a vector fixed in space
The vector (b-c)^2u-(b+c)^2u' (cyclic) obeys the frame equation for the second frame with rates r1=w-w', q1=v-v' (Helmholtz integral)
The kinetic-energy contribution of the zeta-rotation pair equals 2[(a-b)^2w^2+(a+b)^2w'^2], matching the vis-viva integral
In dE/dt the quadratic rotation terms from a'a'' etc. cancel against the explicit time derivatives of the coefficients (partial check of energy conservation)

transcription_corrections: Area integral: '(b-c)^2 u ... (b+c)^2 w'' should read (b-c)^2 u + (b+c)^2 u' = g.
'auf der rechten Seite hat 𝔄 die Form 𝔄 + Aξ²+...' is likely 'hat εV - p die Form 𝔄 + Aξ² + Bη² + Cζ²' (constant plus quadratic form).
The constant written 𝔊 in the a,b,c equations is most likely a pressure constant (𝔓 or 2𝔓), not a new quantity.
'ACZ, ABL' near equation (2) is unreadable and probably refers to the constants 𝔄, 𝔄', 𝔄'' or the analogous quantities for the second frame; the reading is doubtful.
The final line should read 'giebt ein Integral erster Ordnung der Differentialgleichungen (A)'; the left side starts with (1/2)[(da/dt)^2+(db/dt)^2+(dc/dt)^2].
